svg.title: Portfolio Microservice Platform
svg.desc: Workflow-oriented microservice architecture showing online AI serving, content projection, visitor intelligence, notification delivery, and explicit reliability semantics.
svg.text: C4 container view · independently deployable services · explicit API, event and state ownership
